title: 第5章 小试牛刀-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》
content:
第(1/3)页

    昨晚测试天珠，一个目标要持续扫描十分钟左右，才能拿到完整的记忆档案。

    这套流程放在情报工作里，叫精确情报采集——对已锁定的重点目标使用，非常高效实用。

    但问题是，他现在连目标都没有。

    总不能满大街一个一个人扫过去，每个人蹲十分钟。鹏城常住人口一千多万，他就是把自己扫秃噜皮了，也扫不完一个城中村。

    得换个思路。

    顾承安重新坐回桌前，闭上眼，在脑子里复盘昨晚天珠的工作流程。

    启动→锁定单一目标→持续扫描→信息由浅入深逐步释放。

    先出的是基础信息——姓名、年龄、身份证号、手机号、职业。

    后出的是深层内容——人格画像、社会关系、核心记忆片段。

    那前面的基础信息，实际上两三秒就跑完了。真正吃时间的是后面的深度记忆提取。

    如果只要前面那几项呢？

    顾承安在心里对天珠下达了一条新指令：“精简扫描模式，只读取目标的姓名、身份证号、手机号和当前职业，不提取其他记忆。可探测范围内的所有人。”

    脖子上没有任何反应。

    没有震动，没有提示，什么都没有。

    顾承安等了几秒，又等了几秒。

    还是没有。

    他摸了摸挂在脖子上的天珠，表面温度正常，没有发热也没有变冷。跟一块普通石头没区别。

    “收到没有？”

    没回应。

    这东西不像系统，有个面板能交互。天珠更像一个纯硬件设备，你下了指令，它到底接没接收，全凭结果验证。

    行吧。

    顾承安没纠结。验证的方式很简单——找一堆人试试就知道了。

    他拿起床头柜上的黄色头盔，换上黄色的外卖服，拿上车钥匙，出了门。

    自己的小电驴停在楼下巷口。顾承安跨上去，插上钥匙拧了一下，看了下显示板，还是满电！

    打开外卖APP，看了一圈附近的订单。

    目光在地图上划了一下，停在一个位置——鹏城北站。

    高铁站，人流量大，人员密集，来自全国各地，鱼龙混杂。

    最适合测试批量扫描。

    他专门挑了一单终点在高铁站附近的订单。一份酸辣粉加两个卤蛋，送到北站东广场旁边的快捷酒店。

    开干，骑车穿过三条巷子汇入主干道，一路往北。

    到了北站片区，人流肉眼可见地密了起来。拖行李箱的、背大包的、举着手机找路的，各色各样。

    顾承安把餐送到酒店前台，拍照确认，点了送达。

    然后他没急着走。

    把电动车停在东广场外围的非机动车停放区，摘下头盔夹在臂弯里，步行走进了广场。

    他控制着步速，不快不慢，跟普通路人没区别。走到候车厅外面的连廊下，找了根柱子靠着，掏出手机假装看消息。

    人来人往，十米范围内随时都有二三十个人。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Last night when I was testing Dzi Beads, I had to scan a target continuously for about ten minutes to get the complete memory file.

This process is placed in intelligence work and is called precise intelligence collection - it is very efficient and practical when used on key targets that have been locked.

But the problem is, he doesn’t even have a goal now.

You can’t just sweep people across the street and squat for ten minutes each.Pengcheng has a permanent population of more than 10 million. Even if he wipes out his own skin, he still can't wipe out a village in the city.

You have to change your thinking.

Gu Chengan sat back at the table, closed his eyes, and reviewed the work process of Dzi Bead last night in his mind.

Start → lock a single target → continue scanning → gradually release information from shallow to deep.

The first thing to come out is the basic information - name, age, ID number, mobile phone number, and occupation.

What comes out later is the deep content - personality portraits, social relationships, and core memory fragments.

The previous basic information is actually completed in two or three seconds.What really takes time is the deep memory retrieval later.

What if you only need the first few items?

Gu Chengan gave the Dzi Bead a new instruction in his mind: "Simplified scanning mode, which only reads the target's name, ID number, mobile phone number and current occupation, without extracting other memories. It can detect everyone within the range."

There was no reaction on the neck.

No vibration, no prompt, nothing.

Gu Chengan waited for a few seconds, and then waited for a few more seconds.

Still not.

He touched the Dzi beads hanging around his neck. The surface temperature was normal, neither hot nor cold.It is no different from an ordinary stone.

"Did you receive it?"

No response.

This thing is not like a system, there is a panel for interaction.Dzi Beads are more like a pure hardware device. You give a command and whether it receives it depends on the result.



Gu Chengan didn’t hesitate.The method of verification is very simple - just find a bunch of people and try it.

He picked up the yellow helmet on the bedside table, changed into yellow takeout clothes, took the car keys, and went out.

My little electric donkey is parked at the alley downstairs.Gu Chengan stepped up, inserted the key and turned it. He looked at the display panel and saw that it was still fully charged!

Open the takeout app and look around at the nearby orders.

He traced his gaze on the map and stopped at a location - Pengcheng North Station.

The high-speed rail station has a large flow of people and is densely packed with people from all over the country.

​ Best for testing batch scans.

He specifically selected an order that ended near a high-speed rail station.A portion of hot and sour noodles with two braised eggs was delivered to the Express Hotel next to the East Square of North Station.

开干，骑车穿过三条巷子汇入主干道，一路往北。

When we arrived at the North Station area, the flow of people became denser visibly.There are all kinds of people dragging suitcases, carrying large bags, and holding up mobile phones to find the way.

Gu Chengan delivered the meal to the front desk of the hotel, took a photo to confirm, and ordered it to be delivered.

Then he left in no hurry.

Parked the electric car in the non-motor vehicle parking area outside the east square, took off the helmet and put it in the crook of his arm, and walked into the square.

He controls the pace, neither fast nor slow, just like ordinary passers-by.He walked to the corridor outside the waiting hall, found a pillar to lean against, and took out his mobile phone and pretended to read the news.

People come and go, and there are twenty or thirty people within ten meters at any time.
